title: Ring-forming transformation associated with hydrazone changes of hexadecanuclear dysprosium phosphonates

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (102.9 mg, 0.25 mmol) and H2spch (10.9 mg, 0.05 mmol) in 15 mL of CH3OH/DMF (2:1 v/v) was stirred with NaOH (0.05 mmol) for 12 h. C10H7PO3H2 (31.2 mg, 0.15 mmol) was then added to the pale yellow solution. The mixture was stirred for another 24 h and filtered. The yellow filtrate was transferred to 20 mL glassware, sealed, and heated in a drying oven at 90 °C. Pale yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after two weeks as a single-phase product.
synthesis.time: stirred 12 h then 24 h; heated 2 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in sealed 20 mL glassware in a drying oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration of the yellow solution followed by solvothermal crystallization; pale yellow single crystals formed after two weeks

properties.summary: Complex 1 is a Dy16 SMM. Room-temperature χMT is 232.99 cm3 K mol−1 per Dy16, close to 226.72 cm3 K mol−1 for 16 free DyIII ions, then falls to 164.44 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization reaches 92.74 μB at 2.0 K and 70 kOe without saturating. Zero-field ac susceptibility shows slow relaxation with Δ = 51 cm−1 and τ0 = 3.0×10−10 s (α = 0.17–0.32). An optimal 1000 Oe dc field increases the barrier to Δ = 63 cm−1 (τ0 = 2.2×10−10 s, α ≈ 0.13).

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Δ
measurements.conditions: zero dc field Arrhenius fit of ln τ vs 1/T; τ0 = 3.0×10−10 s; α = 0.17–0.32 (1.8–8.5 K Cole–Cole)

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Δ
measurements.conditions: applied dc field 1000 Oe; τ0 = 2.2×10−10 s; α ≈ 0.13

synthesis.procedure: Complex 2 was obtained by the same procedure as 1 except that H2opch (8.2 mg, 0.03 mmol) and KOH (0.05 mmol) replaced H2spch and NaOH. Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (102.9 mg, 0.25 mmol) in 15 mL of CH3OH/DMF (2:1 v/v) was therefore treated analogously with C10H7PO3H2 (31.2 mg, 0.15 mmol), filtered, and heated at 90 °C in sealed 20 mL glassware. Yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after two weeks as a single-phase product.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in sealed 20 mL glassware, analogous to 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow single crystals formed after two weeks as a single-phase product

properties.summary: Complex 2 is a Dy16 SMM. χMT is 230.78 cm3 K mol−1 per Dy16 at room temperature and 147.90 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization reaches 73.37 μB at 2.0 K and 70 kOe. Zero-field ac data give Δ = 15 cm−1 and τ0 = 2.7×10−8 s with a broad τ distribution (α = 0.48–0.63). Under 1000 Oe, a second slower process appears; the fast-relaxation (high-frequency) phase has Δ = 40 cm−1, τ0 = 3.5×10−8 s and α ≈ 0.43.
